title: openOODA Compiler + Runtime
content:
## What it is

The openOODA compiler (`oodac`) and the Gen 1 C runtime. The substrate every other openOODA repo is built on. The compiler emits native code for four targets: bare-metal x86_64/AArch64 ELF, WebAssembly (WasmGC), portable C99, and LLVM IR.

## Install

oda IS the toolchain. Install with `curl -fsSL https://openooda.org/install.sh | bash`; the `ooda` command runs the compiler and runtime from this repo.

## Surface

| Component | Path | Role |
|-----------|------|------|
| Compiler | `oodac/` | Lexer, parser, Merkle AST, SSA mem2reg, direct ELF emission |
| Runtime | `runtime/` | Gen 1 C shims, Landlock sandbox, linear arenas |
| Smoke tests | `smoke/` | End-to-end compiler tests |
| Fixtures | `fixtures/` | Test inputs and expected outputs |
